findings.passage: Senate Bill 1560 brings that protection to Missouri, making sure people with a history of domestic violence can’t find a loophole. Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle agree that people who commit domestic violence shouldn’t have access to firearms.
findings.note: Her Capitol Report describing SB 1560. She says the 2016 constitutional carry law made it easier for people with a domestic violence history to get guns because the permit check was gone, and the bill would mirror the federal ban in state law.
